descriere:
Nivel de vechime: Începător
Tip de angajare: Full-time
Sectoare de activitate: Servicii IT și consultanță IT
Are you at the beginning of your IT career and enjoy helping people solve technical issues?
 Join us as a Junior IT Support and be the first point of contact for users who need assistance.
 In this role, you will provide technical support, troubleshoot IT-related issues, and ensure a smooth user experience. Using your German skills, you will help users find solutions quickly and professionally while contributing to the efficient operation of our IT services.
 Role Essentials 
Language Skills: Proficiency in both German and English is a must.
Availability to work 3 rotating 8-hour shifts, including nights.
 What Will You Be Doing 
Offer technical support to German-speaking clientele through telephonic communication and electronic correspondence.
Diagnose technical problems and deliver effective resolutions to end-users.
Record and track support tickets, ensuring timely resolution in line with SLAs.
Provide efficient support to ensure a positive customer experience.
Escalate complex technical issues to specialized IT teams for faster resolution.
